name: Larvorub
look: a plump lavender-white grub with a cream-banded back, yellow side spots, a brown head with round cheeks, huge green eyes with clover pupils and two yellow-tipped horns
entry: It tunnels through rotting logs on the jungle floor and eats anything softer than its horns. When something startles it, it rears up and points those horns, though they are still too soft to hurt.
how: Wild: common in jungles and savannas.
